items.title: US Treasury chief wants answers soon from Nvidia
items.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called on Nvidia Sunday to explain whether it knowingly allowed its most advanced AI chips to reach China, saying this was more important than ex-CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged spy for Beijing.In late 2025, President Donald Trump did authorize sales of Nvidia chips called H200s to the Chinese -- but not the most advanced chips used to run AI models reshaping modern society.

items.title: Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies, FT reports
items.summary: Nov 15 () - Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia's chief executive, and ‌has discussed with confidants the possibility of ‌returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people ​familiar with the matter. One Huang ally told the FT they were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for the former ‌Nvidia chief's return ⁠and would try to garner support from the White House.
